title: Branch rules
description: Local guardrails GitDesktop enforces in this repository. They help prevent accidents on any repo; GitHub's own protection still applies on push. Patterns are globs: * within one segment, ** across segments, and {a,b} for alternatives.

scope.sharedSavedTail: and committed — everyone with the repo gets them. They combine with each person's personal rules.
scope.personalSaved: Stored on this machine only. Your personal rules combine with the repo's shared rules.

naming.title: New branch names
naming.requirePattern: Require new branches to match a pattern

protection.title: Protected branches
protection.empty: No protected branches. Add one to guard matching branches against deletion, force-pushes, and unwanted merge types.

promotion.title: Promotion branches
promotion.empty: No promotion branches. Add a pattern such as staging or release/* to mark pull requests from that branch as promotions. GitDesktop won't offer to update them from their base.

import.none: No branch protection rules found on GitHub (reading them needs repo-admin access).
import.success_one: Imported {{count}} rule from GitHub — review and save
import.success_other: Imported {{count}} rules from GitHub — review and save

saved.shared: Saved to .gitdesktop/branch-rules.json — commit it to share with your team
